findings.highlight: It’s not like I need to talk to Saber or Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと何を話すでもなく、別棟にいる遠坂と話すでもなく
findings.governingReading: Bedtime arrives without Shirou having spoken to either Saber or Rin.
findings.explanation: The English invents a judgment that conversation is unnecessary, changing omission by circumstance into chosen disinterest.

findings.governingReading: The scene advances to late at night.
findings.explanation: Night falls places the transition around dusk instead of deep night.

findings.highlight: I open my eyes, still on my side.
findings.evidenceJa: 横になったまま目蓋を開く
findings.governingReading: Shirou opens his eyes while still lying down.
findings.explanation: On my side adds a specific posture absent from the source.

findings.highlight: It’s so quiet, so why can I hear Saber’s breathing in the next room?
findings.evidenceJa: 隣の部屋にいるセイバーの寝息が聞こえてくるんだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou starts a complaint, then asks why he can hear Saber breathing despite the silence.
findings.explanation: A broken first attempt and complete second attempt are printed together, duplicating the question.

findings.evidenceJa: こんな針のむしろはもうご免だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou has had enough of lying on metaphorical needles from nervous tension.
findings.explanation: Hell generalizes and intensifies the image while losing its bodily mechanism.

findings.highlight: I retreat. retreat to my usual place.
findings.governingReading: Shirou quietly retreats elsewhere without waking Saber.
findings.explanation: Two assembly variants are fused with a repeated retreat.

findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Saber is insensitive or simply a deep sleeper.
findings.explanation: Must prematurely certifies the insulting first possibility before the immediate alternative.

findings.highlight: She must be defiant, or just adaptable.
findings.evidenceJa: 開き直っているのか、もともと順応力が高いのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou considers whether Rin has brazened it out or was naturally adaptable.
findings.explanation: Must again hardens one side of an explicitly unresolved alternative.

findings.highlight: the bandage wrapped around my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 手のひらに巻かれた包帯
findings.governingReading: The helpful example is the bandage wrapped around Shirou’s palm.
findings.explanation: Hand removes the palm-specific placement before the narration distinguishes the seal on its back.

findings.highlight: around the middle of her right hand, or somewhere like that
findings.evidenceJa: 右腕の真ん中あたりにあるとかないとか
findings.governingReading: By uncertain report, Rin’s mark may be around the middle of her right arm.
findings.explanation: Hand changes the body location from arm while the hedge concerns whether the reported placement is true.

findings.highlight: The strengthening magic, which I succeeded at for the first time in a few years after being attacked by Lancer.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜、ランサーに襲われて何年かぶりに成功した強化の魔術
findings.governingReading: Last night’s Strengthening was his first success in several years, and he now intends to consolidate it.
findings.explanation: The English renders the setup as a sentence fragment.
